The 2025 and 2026 articles (Lloyd show, plus https://arizonawildcats.com/news/2026/8/26/brent-brennan-radio-show-2026) confirm that the Voice of the Wildcats does the coaches' shows on 'Wildcats Radio 1290 AM'. They do not name the call letters or explicitly call it the game flagship. The network name comes from affiliateresources.learfield.com/arizona/, whose station list is password-protected. The Spanish home-game broadcasts on Urbana 92.5 FM come from a 2024 article (https://arizonawildcats.com/news/2024/10/5/...).

Live official page says 'Phoenix - Flagship Station KMVP 98.7FM Football, Men's Basketball' and that FB/MBB stream free on the Arizona Sports App; FB, MBB, WBB and baseball also on SiriusXM. Page content itself carries no season year.

2025 and 2026 articles confirm the network name and Playfly (also https://baylorbears.com/news/2025/8/21/football-nick-florence-to-join-baylor-sports-media-network). KRZI '(flagship)' comes from https://baylorbears.com/sports/2018/5/17/radio, an older page that still lists SiriusXM as 'TBD'. The baylorbears.com homepage (2026) links 'Listen Online' to centexsportsfan.com, which is the KRZI site.

The only radio signal found: ucfknights.com's site-wide 'Listen Live' link points to iHeart '96.9 The Game, Orlando's Sports Leader'. No page naming UCF's network, flagship or MBB station was found (search budget was exhausted). Sports and role are unconfirmed.

2026 article: broadcasts are 'heard across flagship stations 700 WLW, 1530 WCKY, and 1360 WSAI, as well as streaming via the iHeartRadio app'. The per-game flagship is 700 WLW for most games, and 102.7 WEBN for early games that conflict with the Reds. MBB radio station is NOT confirmed; the 10/7/2026 MBB exhibition 'Listen Live' linked to YouTube.

The live official 'Colorado Radio Network' page shows 'Colorado Buffaloes On 850 KOA'. Mark Johnson is in his 23rd year calling FB/MBB, and Gary Barnett is in his 11th full season on the KOA team. The Learfield affiliate list (affiliateresources.learfield.com/colorado-buffaloes/) shows Denver KOA 850 AM for football and MBB. The word 'flagship' is not used. The Varsity App is linked from the Learfield page.

teams.note: A 2024 article announced a six-year extension: Stillwater Radio is the 'flagship broadcast partner', and HOT 93.7 (KSPI-FM) airs all FB, MBB, baseball and wrestling. Streams are at StillwaterRadio.net, OkState.com, and the KSPI, Go Pokes and Varsity apps. A 2026 article (https://okstate.com/news/2026/4/16/...) confirms the Cowboy Radio Network name. OKC and Tulsa stations come from the Learfield list (c2026) and the okstate.com Radio Network page.
